title: RelayIQ
summary: Spend control for lead enrichment. Sits between Clay-style workflows and the CRM. Decides per record whether paying for enrichment is worth it, and keeps low-confidence data out of the CRM.
note: In a simulated benchmark of 495 submissions, cost per usable lead fell from 13.24 to 4.65 credits and field precision rose from 0.68 to 0.78. Providers were simulated, not live vendors.
caption: Decides before it spends; benchmarks use simulated providers.
